author: The Infographics Show
description:
Russia is facing questions after a deadly incident at an anti-plague laboratory in Siberia. A 28-year-old lab technician died days after reportedly being exposed to Yersinia pestis, the bacterium responsible for plague.

Authorities then placed nearly 200 people under medical observation, locked down hospital wards, canceled public events, and introduced emergency anti-epidemic measures around Irkutsk. Russian officials insist there is no plague outbreak and say the worker died from pneumonia of unknown origin. But the scale of the response has fueled suspicion.
Why were hospitals restricted, contacts isolated, and top health officials rushed thousands of miles from Moscow if the situation was routine?

The official story says everything is under control, but the emergency measures tell a more complicated story.
